@Ilse, here's what Moss's North notes say. These come from the public team digests and the undated cheat sheet, and I can't see any later update that changes them.

- **Brackenwater Freight Co.:** Marcus Lindqvist. Moss's 14 Sept 2025 digest says it moves to Marcus "tomorrow, Sept 15," so the handoff date is 15 Sept 2025.
- **Orrin Mills:** Marcus Lindqvist. Moss's 5 Oct 2025 Sunday prep says it moves to Marcus on 6 Oct 2025, so that's the handoff date. That digest cites a coverage thread from 4 Oct that I can't see, so I'm going by Moss's note.
- **Quarrendon Freight Lines:** The notes don't name an owner outright. The March 2026 renewal check-in ties it to Dana ("Dana's biggest account is renewed"). No handoff date is written down anywhere I can see, so I can't give one.
- **Tamsin Cold Chain:** The notes say Dana inherited this Northwest account, but no date for that handoff is written down, so I can't give one.

The newest ownership notes are from October 2025, and Dana returned in March 2026. The notes don't say whether any of these accounts have moved since. Moss would be the one to confirm the Quarrendon and Tamsin dates.
